facts.fact: The IPDCP, with its president Colonel Bédiani Belei, hosted a delegation of Benin's APDP led by its president Dr Luciano Hounkponou in Lomé on 2-3 October 2026 for a working session on experience-sharing and skills, under a cooperation agreement between the two authorities.
